candidates.name: IndoorGML
verified_facts: IndoorGML specifies an open data model and XML schema for indoor spatial information.
It intentionally focuses on modelling indoor spaces for navigation purposes.
semantic_limits: Indoor navigation-space topology does not establish outdoor parcel terrain height, ground classification or vertical survey uncertainty.

candidates.name: LandInfra / InfraGML
verified_facts: InfraGML encodes concepts from the OGC Land and Infrastructure conceptual model covering land features, facilities, alignment, survey, land division and related infrastructure topics.
The multi-part standard includes survey equipment, observations and survey results as modelled information.
semantic_limits: Encoding survey concepts or results does not independently certify the observations, datum, equipment calibration or parcel elevation accuracy.
